description.value:
You reach into the well of magic within you and ignite the dracoleum within, launching a blast of energy through your maw. You exhale a breath weapon dealing 1d4 damage of a damage type you have access to. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, and you can’t use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels onward you increase the damage you deal by 1d4. When you take this feat, you determine whether your breath weapon is a 15-foot cone or a 30-foot line, and choose the saving throw used for the breath weapon that is appropriate to your selected trait for your Benefactor’s energy type. If you have multiple traits, select one. These choices are permanent.
